Package dev.relism.flash.http

Class Http1Limits

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Http1Limits
public final class Http1Limits extends Object
The bounds the HTTP/1.1 parser (RequestParser, ChunkedInputStream, Multipart) enforces against a peer's input, in one place. Every check compares against a constant here, never against a literal and never by letting a buffer overrun. The body as a whole is bounded per server by ServerConfig.maxBodySize.

Compare dev.relism.flash.http2.Http2Limits, the HTTP/2 equivalent.
